title: Book Two · Chapter 79: The Empty Saturday
story:
The Saturday before school begins, Leo has no reading morning. The roof has a leak. The room needs work, so the adults cancel the activity. Leo comes to Ronan in the afternoon with the message.

“Will you go another day?” Ronan asks.

“They will tell us.”

Leo sounds cross. He drops onto the low step and puts his chin in his hands.

Ronan remembers the little sadness after his own single visit. Part of him wants to say that Leo can miss one morning. He has so many others. He looks at his friend's face. He says nothing.

“Do you want the ball?”

“Not yet.”

They sit for a while. The black cat walks through the gate, sees Leo's shoes and turns toward the wall instead.

“It has plans,” Ronan says.

“Better plans than mine.”

Ronan gets up and brings two clean scraps of card. He puts one on the step in front of Leo.

“Make a house.”

“For the cat?”

“For anything.”

They fold the cards into little roofs. Ronan draws a window. Leo draws a door too small for his own finger. They stand the roofs on the dry step. They put tiny stones beside them.

Jun arrives while they are making a path. He has a piece of string in his pocket. They ask Mum first. Then they use the string for a little road across the yard. The real gate stays clear.

Soon they have two houses, a small shop and a square. Leo makes a sign for the shop. Ronan reads it aloud. “What does your shop sell?”

“Stones.”

“Expensive stones?”

“One stone for two stones.”

Jun gives Leo one. Leo gives him two back. After three visits, the shop has almost nothing left. Leo looks into his empty hand.

“That is not a good shop,” Ronan says.

“It has very happy customers.”

Mum comes to look. She asks them to clear the path before supper. Dad checks a flat board for rough edges. It is safe, so they move the small town onto it.

The black cat returns. It steps across the string road and puts one foot straight into the square. All three boys make warning noises. The cat sits beside the shop. It looks very pleased with the whole town.

Leo laughs at last. He moves his tiny sign away from the cat's tail. When he goes home, he takes his card roof with him. He still missed his reading morning. But now he has a new house in his bag.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

empty＝空的；cancel＝取消；message＝消息。

## 理解问题

1. Leo的活动为什么取消？
2. 朋友怎样改成一个有趣的下午？

## 读句子

**Ronan / gets up / and brings two clean scraps of card.** Ronan／起身／拿来两张干净的小卡纸。
